name: Dekella
description: Thassa's magical bident, which greatly increases Kiora's control over the sea.

description_citations.text: "Kiora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The narrator recalls the legends of heroes such as Vinack, Aesrias, Solon and Kedarick VI that inspired her as an orphan thief.
timeline.quote: Even as a young thief outside of the academies, you learned about the great heroes.

citation.text: "Desperate Stand" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: After a battle with sea monsters, Kiora escapes with Thassa's bident Dekella.
timeline.quote: Kiora escaped mostly unharmed and clutching Thassa's magical bident Dekella .

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jori En finds the wounded Kiora and they retrieve her bident.
timeline.quote: Jori En found the wounded Kiora amidst a mass of dead sea creatures.

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack Fayden touches Kiora's bident to copy it, and she catches him.
timeline.quote: She caught him, and the attempt made him look like he regretted his decision.

citation.text: "Kiora", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A mortal steals Dekella to destroy a rival fleet and Thassa turns his family into eels (legend).
timeline.quote: Thassa turned his family into eels

citation.text: "Thassa", section "Divine weapon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiora steals Dekella and Thassa receives a new divine spear from Purphoros.
timeline.quote: Dekella was later stolen by the planeswalker Kiora

citation.text: "Thassa", section "Divine weapon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
